# Drugs.com

> Comprehensive pharmaceutical reference providing FDA prescribing information, dosage guides, medication identification, and patient safety resources.

Drugs.com is a leading medication information resource offering healthcare professionals and patients access to drug dosing, side effects, interactions, and FDA-approved prescribing information. The site covers a wide range of medications from stimulants and fertility treatments to cardiovascular and immunological drugs.

## Key Topics

- FDA prescribing information
- Dosage guides
- Side effects
- Medication interactions
- Amphetamine
- ADHD treatment
- Narcolepsy
- Fertility medications
- Clomiphene
- Lisinopril
- Pill identifier
- Pediatric dosing
- Extended-release formulations
- Dose adjustments
- Patient medication guides

## Dosage Guides & Clinical References

- [Amphetamine Dosage Guide + Max Dose, Adjustments](https://failover.drugs.com/dosage/amphetamine.html): Amphetamine dosage guide with max doses and adjustments for ADHD, narcolepsy, and obesity.
- [Clinoril - FDA Prescribing Information, Side Effects and Uses](https://failover.drugs.com/pro/clinoril.html): FDA prescribing information for Clinoril (sulindac) NSAID with pharmacology and interactions.

## Patient Medication Guides

- [Serophene: Indications, Side Effects, Warnings](https://failover.drugs.com/cdi/serophene.html): Patient leaflet for Serophene (clomiphene) fertility medication with indications and side effects.
- [Rh(D) Immune Globulin: Indications, Side Effects, Warnings](https://failover.drugs.com/cdi/rh-d-immune-globulin.html): Patient medication guide for Rh(D) Immune Globulin with indications, warnings, and dosage.

## Pill Identifier & Drug Lookup

- [GP Pill Orange Round 8mm - Pill Identifier](https://failover.drugs.com/imprints/gp-150-1636.html): Pill identifier tool identifying Lisinopril 30mg by imprint code GP 150.
